meta_description: Golden paths, paved roads — an internal platform that turns months into days.

blocks.x: Golden paths, paved roads — an internal platform that turns months into days.

Every hour an engineer spends fighting infrastructure is an hour not spent on the product. We build internal developer platforms: golden-path templates (service scaffolding, pipelines, observability, security defaults), a self-service catalog (Backstage-class) with scorecards, environment provisioning in minutes under policy, and a paved road so compelling that the secure path is also the easiest path.

Developer experience is measured, not vibes: DORA metrics (lead time, deployment frequency, change-failure rate, MTTR), onboarding time-to-first-commit, and platform NPS from the engineers themselves. The platform team runs as a product team with a roadmap and a budget — the organizational pattern that separates platforms people adopt from platforms people route around.
